items.title: NASA Science
items.summary: Cruising through the outer solar system, the Voyager 2 spacecraft made its closest approach to Neptune on August 25, 1989, the only spacecraft to visit the most distant ice giant planet. Based on the images recorded during its close encounter and in the following days, this inspired composited scene covers the dim outer planet, largest moon Triton, and faint system of rings. items.label: Poem
items.title: חיים נחמן ביאליק — הכניסיני תחת כנפך
items.summary:
וְעוֹד רָז אֶחָד לָךְ אֶתְוַדֶּה:
נַפְשִׁי נִשְׂרְפָה בְלַהֲבָהּ;
אוֹמְרִים, אַהֲבָה יֵשׁ בָּעוֹלָם –
מַה־זֹּאת אַהֲבָה?

items.title: An Isolated Group of Amazonian Hunter-Gatherers Made a Rare Request for Help From Outsiders, Raising Concerns About Forest Degradation
items.summary: Around 20 members of the Indigenous Awá tribe emerged from the rainforest and received food from neighboring villagers. The group has not made contact with the outside world in decades, so experts say deforestation may have left these individuals with no other option

items.label: History
items.title: Teeth Discovered in Two Chinese Caves Are Rewriting the Story of Homo Erectus, an Ancient Human Ancestor That May Have Been More Capable Than We Thought
items.summary: One new study suggests that the species persisted in mainland Asia for 216,000 years longer than previously thought. Another says Homo erectus was capable of living in a tropical rainforest, a discovery that turns a common extinction theory "on its head," according to one researcher
